facts.fact: Access selects DACL, distinct from Audit/SACL, Owner and Group sections; applies to .NET Framework as well as current .NET.
The includeSections overload retrieves specified ACL information into DirectorySecurity.
SetAccessControl applies modified DirectorySecurity ACLs and does not persist an unmodified object. Its documented update pattern retrieves, modifies and persists the descriptor.

DACL setting requires WRITE_DAC or ownership; owner setting has distinct WRITE_OWNER/take-ownership and token eligibility rules, with SeRestore relevant to arbitrary owner eligibility. Certain SACL/scope flags require SeSecurity. This diagnostic does not establish which native flags or privilege caused the observed exception.
Persist section selection must match the intended initialized sections; loading Access then persisting All can create unpredictable owner/group/audit values.
